summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing its intent to increase the maximum aggregate offering sizes of its existing at-the-market (ATM) programs for Class A common stock and Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock by $2.1 billion each, to $2.55 billion and $2.6 billion respectively. The amendments are subject to filing applicable documentation. This is a routine capital-raising adjustment to existing shelf programs, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The filing includes forward-looking statements about a merger with Semler Scientific, but the core disclosure is an ATM program update. No specific terms, prices, or timetables are provided; the event is an ordinary financing update.
